items.action: None, unless the app sets data-theme on <html> before startup and still wants the OS to drive the theme: set that attribute before startup only when the user has saved a choice.
items.appliesWhen: Apps calling provideDsTheme({ followSystem: true }) whose <html> already carries data-theme when the app starts, from index.html or a pre-bootstrap script. Apps without followSystem, or with no data-theme at startup, are unchanged.
items.pitfall: A data-theme hard-coded in index.html now pins the theme for every user, so the OS switch silently stops working.
items.verify: with followSystem on, an <html> that starts with data-theme keeps that value across an OS colour-scheme change, and one that starts without it follows the OS.

items.action: None, unless a group projects more avatars than max and all of them should stay visible: raise max to that count.
items.appliesWhen: ds-avatar-group elements projecting more ds-avatar children than max (default 4), or projecting more than max with no total. Groups projecting max or fewer avatars render as before.
items.verify: a group projecting more avatars than max shows max avatars followed by a +N chip whose N is the hidden count, or total - max when total is set.

items.action: None, unless one of these overlays projects content that was meant to stay hidden: put it behind an @if or take it out of the overlay. Move any other content without a slot into its slot (<div body> on ds-modal and ds-modal-card, <div drawer-body> on ds-drawer) to clear the dev-mode warning.
items.appliesWhen: Direct children of ds-modal or ds-modal-card without [eyebrow], [title-badge], [body], [impact] or [actions], and of ds-drawer without [drawer-body], [body], [drawer-footer] or [actions]; a ds-drawer child carrying [body] or [actions] now renders too. Slotted content renders as before; ds-bottom-sheet is not affected.
items.pitfall: The content shows in production as well, and the console warning is the only signal, so an app that is never run in dev mode shows it with no warning.
items.verify: With the app in dev mode, open every ds-modal and ds-drawer and confirm the console logs no [ds-modal], [ds-modal-card] or [ds-drawer] warning about content without a slot or an unknown slot.

items.action: None, unless tests or screenshots run against a dev build and a toast in view breaks them: set provideDsConfig({ toast: { mirrorDevWarnings: false } }) in that build.
items.appliesWhen: Apps that inject ToastService, in dev mode only. A production build, and an app that never injects ToastService, shows no such toast.
items.pitfall: The toasts appear only when a library warning fires, so a test suite can pass on one screen and fail on the next one that warns.
items.verify: In a dev build with ToastService injected, a library warning in the console is matched by one warning toast titled Dev warning, and with mirrorDevWarnings: false by none.

items.old: AvatarGroupComponent, ChartComponent, ColumnSeriesComponent, ModalComponent, ModalCardComponent, DrawerComponent, PieChartComponent
items.action: Build after upgrading, and rename a member of yours the compiler reports as colliding.
items.appliesWhen: Only a class of yours that extends AvatarGroupComponent, ChartComponent, ColumnSeriesComponent, ModalComponent, ModalCardComponent, DrawerComponent or PieChartComponent. Template users of ds-avatar-group, ds-chart, dsColumnSeries, ds-modal, ds-modal-card, ds-drawer and ds-pie-chart need nothing; subclassing a DS component is unsupported.
items.pitfall: A redeclared private member collides as a public one does, and override cannot resolve it (TS2415); only a rename does.
items.verify: The app builds with no TS2415 or TS4114 against AvatarGroupComponent, ChartComponent, ColumnSeriesComponent, ModalComponent, ModalCardComponent, DrawerComponent or PieChartComponent, and no TS2554 or TS2425 on bandPinY.
items.note: AvatarGroupComponent gained the private avatars; ChartComponent the protected highlightBand and tooltipGap and the private bandAt, hoveredCategory and pinRise; ColumnSeriesComponent the private pinYOf; ModalComponent, ModalCardComponent and DrawerComponent the private unslotted; PieChartComponent the inputs centerCompact and centerPlacement, the protected centerText and centerFontSize, and the private compactCenterValue, ringElement, centerValueElement, centerFit, ringWidth, fitsInside, fitCenter, watchRing and refit. ChartComponent's protected bandPinY is now a computed signal read as bandPinY(), where it was a method taking the band.

informational.text: ds-pie-chart no longer wraps its centre value: it stays on one line and shrinks to the hole, down to --ds-pie-chart-center-value-min-font-size (14px); past that floor the computed sum prints in the 'tick' form of valueFormat (32.4K), unless [centerCompact]="false". A centerValue string is shrunk but never shortened.
informational.verify: render a donut at --ds-pie-chart-size: 120px with innerRadius 0.61 and a sum of 32,397, and confirm the value sits on one line inside the hole; at 90px with a sum of 1,234,567 it reads 1.2M.

informational: ds-pie-chart takes centerCompact (default true) and centerPlacement ('inside' | 'below', default 'inside'; type PieChartCenterPlacement), and the --ds-pie-chart-center-value-min-font-size token.

--ds-topbar-crumb-text-color, --ds-topbar-crumb-hover-text-color, --ds-topbar-crumb-separator-icon-color, --ds-topbar-crumb-current-text-color, --ds-page-header-crumb-text-color and --ds-page-header-crumb-text-color-hover now recolour the projected ds-breadcrumbs, where they changed nothing; an app that set them sees those colours take effect.
ds-bar-chart draws a row with a negative value as an empty track labelled with that value, where it drew a bar of the absolute value labelled 0.

ds-button with routerLink or href, disabled and a disabledReason keeps a Tab stop (tabindex 0, role link) so the reason is announced; without disabledReason a disabled link-button still takes tabindex -1; a disabled routerLink button carries role link with or without a reason.

provideDsIcons calls merge: sibling calls and a lazy route's call add to the icons registered above them, a later call winning a shared name, where each call replaced the previous registry. DS_ICON_REGISTRY now reads the merged registry.

ds-modal confirmed fires when a projected element carrying the new dsModalConfirm directive (ModalConfirmActionDirective) is pressed; before, nothing emitted it. A handler that emitted confirmed by hand keeps working.

informational.text: ds-chart, ds-column-chart and dsColumnSeries draw a held category's pin at the head of the reading its panel opens over instead of at the plot's foot (over a column too short to hold it, with the panel lifted over the disc), and paints its hover band (--ds-chart-hover-bg-color) under a pin only where the pointer is; ds-bar-chart draws a held bar's pin at the middle of the bar instead of its start; ds-line-chart, a line series in ds-chart and ds-scatter-chart draw a held marker's or point's pin 4px higher.
informational.verify: pin a category in a composed ds-chart and a row in a ds-bar-chart, move the pointer off the plot, and confirm the pin sits right under the panel and no band stays tinted; pin a marker in a ds-line-chart and confirm its disc sits 8px clear of the marker.

informational.text: ds-banner centres its icon on the capitals of the title and body instead of on their line boxes, and drops the title-to-body gap when there is no title, so a banner with no title and a body of more than one line is up to 4px shorter; every other banner keeps its height.
informational.verify: open a compact and a regular ds-banner with body text and no title, and confirm the icon's middle sits level with the middle of the capital letters, not above them.

informational.text: ds-modal, ds-modal-card and ds-drawer render content without a slot inside a display: contents wrapper placed after the [body] / [drawer-body] content; slotted content keeps its place and spacing.
informational.verify: open a ds-modal and a ds-drawer whose content is all slotted and confirm the body spacing and scrolling are unchanged.

informational: A library dev warning logs once per page instead of once per instance; the ds-table export warning now starts with [ds-table], and the ds-app-layout --bp-lg message is logged with console.warn instead of console.error.
